name: ASM-027 compact wireless mouse assembly benchmark
description: Intermediate hierarchical CAD assembly benchmark for a compact wireless mouse with lower shell, raised palm shell, click panels, scroll wheel, optical sensor, side grips, and skid feet.

tasks.prompt: Create a compact wireless mouse assembly with a lower shell, raised palm shell, left and right click panels, center spine, scroll wheel, optical sensor window, battery door, side grips, status LED, and underside skid feet. Use robust primitive geometry and omit logos or trademark text.
assumptions: This is a generic wireless mouse benchmark and does not model proprietary branding or exact ergonomic surfaces.
The raised palm shape is approximated with simple box modules for robust STEP generation rather than fragile freeform surfacing.
Generated STEP, GLB, topology, and component artifacts are produced by the CAD pipeline and are not hand-edited source of truth.
